verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a datacenter GPU, but the pack has no documented power envelope figures, no performance-per-watt claims and no independent efficiency testing. The power-related items only say nvidia-smi reports maximum GPU power and describe PSU redundancy. Those are adjacent operational details, not evidence that sustained workloads are power-efficient. The community benchmark comment covers raw performance versus H200, not efficiency.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, sustained workloads are power-efficient on this part — documented power envelopes with independent performance-per-watt testing
